title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ollie Gordon II uninvolved in loss Sunday
items.desc: Ollie Gordon II rushed the ball three times for seven yards in Sunday's 35-13 loss to the San Francisco 49ers.
items.impact: Gordon didn't play much on Sunday, seeing just three touches in Miami's three-score loss to the 49ers. He hasn't shown much involvement at all over the first two weeks of the season, so fantasy managers shouldn't consider rostering him for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kendrick Bourne quiet in loss Sunday
items.desc: Kendrick Bourne caught 2-of-3 targets for just 11 yards in Sunday's 31-7 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: Bourne came back down to earth in Week 2 after a stellar performance in Arizona's season opener a week before. He only caught two passes for 11 yards on Sunday, but Arizona's offense as a whole struggled in this matchup against Seattle, so there's a good chance that he will bounce back and have relevance as a depth piece in most leagues sometime in the near future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Travis Etienne Jr. underwhelming in win Sunday
items.desc: Travis Etienne Jr. rushed the ball eight times for 25 yards and caught two passes for six yards in Sunday's 24-17 win over the Baltimore Ravems.
items.impact: Week 2 exposed some major concerns for Etienne. Not only did he have a bad game as far as efficiency and fantasy output go, but the return of Alvin Kamara is proving to be a big issue for his fantasy value, as the 31-year old saw one more carry and four more targets in his first game back from injury. Unless this distribution of work changes in the near future, it looks like Etienne is going to have a volatile week-to-week ceiling with the presence of Kamara eating into his workload that much.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Micheal Clemons (toe) lands on IR
items.desc: Micheal Clemons (toe) was placed on IR by the Colts on Tuesday.
items.impact: Clemons sustained a toe injury in Monday night's game against the Chiefs. He will now have to miss at least the next four weeks. Clemons was signed to a three-year deal back in March after spending his first four NFL seasons with the Jets. Rookie Caden Curry could be in line for more playing time.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Austin Ekeler working out with Carolina on Wednesday
items.desc: Austin Ekeler is working out for the Carolina Panthers on Wednesday. This news comes alongside of Jonathon Brooks missing the next month and a half due to surgery.
items.impact: Panthers starter Chuba Hubbard is not a pass catching specialist, and Ekeler was one of the best pass catching running backs in the business for a time, making this potential pairing intriguing. Ekeler has been cleared for football activities after recovering from a torn Achilles he suffered last season, but it will be interesting to see what sort of shape he's currently in. Chuba should still retain the majority of the volume, but Ekeler could be an interesting flex play in PPR formats should he make the team.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jonathon Brooks (groin) undergoing surgery, will miss about 6 weeks
items.desc: Jonathon Brooks (groin) is expected to undergo surgery on his core to repair an injury he sustained on Sunday. His expected time to recover is six weeks and is expected to land on IR.
items.impact: It's a tough blow for Brooks, who had just gotten back to the playing field after roughly two years away from it. When Brooks returns, he'll still have time to make some noise before the season ends, but there's no telling how much work he will get. Chuba Hubbard will carry the load in Carolina with Brooks out, so be expecting at least RB2 numbers from him thanks to volume.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Hayden Rucci signed by Chargers
items.desc: The Chargers signed TE Hayden Rucci off the Jaguars' practice squad.
items.impact: Rucci is a depth addition for the Chargers with David Njoku and Charlie Kolar placed on injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Onwenu (ankle) placed on IR
items.desc: The Patriots placed Mike Onwenu on injured reserve.
items.impact: Onwenu went down this past Sunday against the Steelers. He will miss at least four games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bishop Fitzgerald signs with Lions
items.desc: The Lions signed S Bishop Fitzgerald off the Steelers' practice squad.
items.impact: Fitzgerald will add depth in the secondary for Detroit.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Charlie Kolar (forearm) to undergo surgery, miss at least four weeks
items.desc: Chargers TE Charlie Kolar is undergoing surgery and plans to return in four weeks.
items.impact: Kolar will aim to return in late October.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Anthony Belton (elbow) limited in practice
items.desc: Anthony Belton was limited in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Belton is Green Bay's new starting right tackle with Zach Bako-Bewele done for the season. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jayden Reed (neck) uncertain on returning this season
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said "it's way too early" to determine whether WR Jayden Reed resumes playing this season.
items.impact: LaFleur clarified it was a neck injury for Reed as reports have continued to go back-and-forth between a neck and back injury. Reed is back in Green Bay and is going through a series of tests.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joe Bachie released by Lions
items.desc: The Lions released LB Joe Bachie.
items.impact: Bachie will seek another opportunity. He has not seen the field this season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam Darnold (glute) 'has a chance' to return in Week 3
items.desc: Sam Darnold reportedly "has a chance" to return in Week 3 against the Commanders.
items.impact: Darnold is expected to return to practice this week. Drew Lock is still likely to start another game, but it is a positive report on Darnold nonetheless.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) 'expected' to return in Week 3
items.desc: Brock Bowers is reportedly "expected" to return this week.
items.impact: It was previously reported that Bowers was expected to practice this week after he returned to practice last Friday. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) day-to-day
items.desc: Steelers RB Rico Dowdle is considered day-to-day with a toe injury.
items.impact: Dowdle was carted to the locker room on Sunday with the injury. He checked out "relatively OK" following tests.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mason Taylor (thumb) week-to-week
items.desc: Jets TE Mason Taylor is week-to-week with a thumb injury.
items.impact: Taylor will likely be sidelined this week for the Jets.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandin Cooks signs with 49ers practice squad
items.desc: The 49ers signed WR Brandin Cooks to their practice squad.
items.impact: Cooks will be entering year 13 in the NFL. He'll add depth in the wide receiver room for San Francisco.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brian Robinson Jr. (ankle) logs full practice Tuesday
items.desc: Brian Robinson Jr. was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Robinson is dealing with an ankle injury. He is on track to be good to go in his backup role on Thursday against the Packers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) logs full practice Tuesday
items.desc: Tua Tagovailoa was a full participant in practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Tagovailoa has missd the first two weeks of the season due to an oblique injury. Michael Penix Jr. was already named the starter, so Tagovailoa would figure to back him up if he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Johnny Hekker signs with Vikings
items.desc: The Vikings signed four-time Pro Bowl P Johnny Hekker.
items.impact: Hekker is back with the team after being released in August.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Darius Rush signs with Steelers practice squad
items.desc: The Steelers signed DB Darius Rush to their practice squad.
items.impact: Rush will add depth in the secondary for Pittsburgh.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Isaiah Hodgins signs with Steelers practice squad
items.desc: The Steelers signed WR Isaiah Hodgins to their practice squad.
items.impact: Hodgins will add depth in the wide receiver room with Pittsburgh.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cal Adomitis signs with Saints
items.desc: The Saints signed LS Cal Adomitis off the Dolphins practice squad.
items.impact: Adomitis will add depth at long snapper for New Orleans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaret Patterson signs with Vikings
items.desc: The Vikings signed RB Jaret Patterson to their practice squad.
items.impact: Patterson was with the Chargers last season. He'll add depth in the backfield for Minnesota.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick McCloud returns to Bears
items.desc: The Bears brought back Nick McCloud to their practice squad.
items.impact: McCloud played in 15 games for them last season and started in four.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Love says elbow is non-issue for Week 3
items.desc: Jordan Love told reporters that his elbow injury is a non-issue for Week 3 against the Falcons.
items.impact: Love said discomfort in his elbow went away before Jets game ended. He indicated the elbow is a non-issue for the Falcons game, even on a short week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ihmir Smith-Marsette signs with Panthers
items.desc: The Panthers signed WR Ihmir Smith-Marsette to their practice squad.
items.impact: Smith-Marsette will add depth at wide receiver and on special teams for Carolina.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marcelino McCrary-Ball (ankle) placed on injured reserve
items.desc: Marcelino McCrary-Ball (ankle) has been placed on injured reserve and will be out for at least four weeks.
items.impact: The Jets have placed several players on injured reserve this week, including McCrary-Ball, who will now miss at least four weeks due to an ankle injury. His absence shouldn't have a big impact on the team for the foreseeable future, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Onyemata (groin) lands on injured reserve
items.desc: David Onyemata (groin) has been placed on injured reserve, knocking him out for the next four weeks at least.
items.impact: The Jets are losing a key starter on their defensive line. Onyemata suffered a groin injury in Week 2 and now lands on injured reserve, which guarantees an absence of at least six weeks for him. New York's defensive front will look weaker without him for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Arian Smith (knee) placed on injured reserve
items.desc: Arian Smith (knee) has been placed on injured reserve and will be sidelined for at least the next four weeks.
items.impact: Smith recently suffered a knee injury and finds himself on injured reserve as a result. He will be sidelined for at least the next four weeks as a result, but his absence isn't expected to have a big impact on New York's offense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Bako-Bewele out for season with torn patellar tendon
items.desc: Packers RT Zach Bako-Bewele has been ruled out for the season with a torn patellar tendon.
items.impact: Bako-Bewele suffered the injury in Sunday's overtime win over the Jets. He was told he has a nine-month recovery timeline from his current injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andre Jones Jr. signs with Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins signed OLB Andre Jones Jr. off Bills' practice squad.
items.impact: Jones will add depth in the linebacker room for Miami.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Scott Daly signed by Bears
items.desc: The Bears signed long snapper Scott Daly off the New Orleans practice squad.
items.impact: Daly will add depth for Chicago.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jaxson Dart (knee) testing reveals knee injury could be season-ending
items.desc: Jaxson Dart (knee) has undergone further testing on his injured knee and they have revealed it could be a season-ending injury. What looked like a promising 2026 is quickly turning upside down for the Giants.
items.impact: Dart went down early in the first quarter with a knee injury, and did not return despite pushing to come back into the game. Now with testing revealing that his injuries could be season-ending, it's a massive blow to fantasy managers. Jameis Winston looked shell shocked for the majority of his snaps, a far cry from the Jameis we've come to know and love over the past few seasons. There are a few comforts we can take from his performance, one is the fact that top WR Malik Nabers hurt his shoulder and was playing through pain. The other is that he will not have to face the Rams pass rush again this season. He could still be a streaming option if Dart is out, but don't start him right away as we want to see a bit more promise of a bounce back first.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Tyson Bagent (concussion) in concussion protocol, could miss Week 3
items.desc: Tyson Bagent (concussion) is in the NFL's concussion protocol and could miss the Bears' Monday night game against the Eagles. If he does, Case Keenum will likely start with Caleb Williams all but out several weeks.
items.impact: Bagent came in relief of the injured Caleb Williams and was having decent success in moving the ball on a potential game winning drive before stalling in the red zone. If Bagent can't go, Case Keenum will start. Keenum has had success in the past and isn't a bad third stringer to have on a real life roster, but isn't someone you should look to start this weekend in fantasy if you can help it.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ryan Schernecke signs with Giants practice squad
items.desc: The Giants signed OL Ryan Schernecke back to their practice squad.
items.impact: Schernecke was released by the Giants last week. He'd been with the team since signing as an undrafted free agent in April.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: James Brockermeyer released by Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons released James Brockermeyer.
items.impact: Brockermeyer will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colby Sorsdal signs with Falcons practice squad
items.desc: The Falcons signed Colby Sorsdal to their practice squad.
items.impact: Sorsdal will add depth for Atlanta.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Harrison signs to Falcons 53-man roster
items.desc: The Falcons signed DE Zach Harrison to their 53-man roster.
items.impact: Harrison will add depth on the defensive line for Atlanta.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jimmy Ciarlo released by Titans
items.desc: The Titans released Jimmy Ciarlo.
items.impact: Tennessee signed Drew Moss as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Drew Moss signs with Titans
items.desc: The Titans signed Drew Moss to their practice squad.
items.impact: Tennessee released Jimmy Ciarlo as the corresponding move.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Kenny Moore II signs to Eagles practice squad
items.desc: The Philadelphia Eagles signed Kenny Moore II to their practice squad on Tuesday.
items.impact: Moore has spent his entire nine-year career with the Colts, earning a Pro Bowl appearance in 2021. The defensive back started seven games for the Colts last season and will look to earn a spot on the active roster with the Eagles.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: A.J. Terrell Jr. (groin) placed on IR
items.desc: A.J. Terrell Jr. was placed on IR on Tuesday with a groin injury.
items.impact: Terrell left Sunday's game against the Panthers early due to a groin injury, and he will now miss at least the next four games. The 27-year-old has started at least 15 games for Atlanta in each of the last three seasons, so Terrell will be a big hole to fill in the coming weeks.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Zach Ertz signs with Eagles
items.desc: The Philadelphia Eagles signed veteran Zach Ertz on Tuesday.
items.impact: Ertz is making his return to the team that he has played the majority of his career for after spending the last four seasons with Arizona and Washington. The veteran will likely be eased back into action, but he could see significant playing time with starter Dallas Goedert sidelined for the near future with an MCL sprain.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bailey Zappe released by Jets
items.desc: The Jets released QB Bailey Zappe.
items.impact: Zappe will figure to seek another opportunity. The Jets signed QB Will Levis to their practice squad.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Levis signs with Jets practice squad
items.desc: The Jets signed QB Will Levis to their practice squad.
items.impact: Levis previously worked out for the Jets. He'll add depth in their quarterback room. Bailey Zappe was released as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brian Burns suffers low ankle sprain
items.desc: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said Brian Burns sustained a low ankle sprain in Week 2 against the Rams.
items.impact: Burns suffered the sprain in the fourth quarter of Monday's blowout loss. He was diagnosed with a low ankle sprain. His status is uncertain for Week 3.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Puka Nacua (hip) uncertain for Week 3
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay said he's "not sure" if Puka Nacua will play in Week 3.
items.impact: McVay said he's "hopeful" Nacua will be able to suit up against Denver next week. If he remains sidelined, Davante Adams and Terrance Ferguson would remain in bigger roles.
